objects.name: Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million
objects.description: Online fashion retailer Revolve has told regulators that the September cyberattack affected more than 1.5 million individuals. The post Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .
